# Study information {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

## Outcome data: B-SPATIAL registry {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

### Research questions {.tabset}

* **Primarily analysis**:       
<br><br>
  **RQ1**: Is there an **association between short-term increases in PM2.5 concentration and the odds of ischemic stroke and transient ischemic attacks among participants of the Berlin-based B-SPATIAL stroke registry**?

<br><br>
<br><br>
<br><br>
* **Secondary analysis**:      
<br><br>
  **RQ2**: If there is an association between PM2.5 short-term exposure and stroke, **at which time lag is it the strongest** (based on hours and the symptom onset time; Lags: **6-36 hours (single hour steps)**, **06-36 hours (cumulative hourly intervals)**.
<br><br>
<br><br>
<br><br> 

```{r sessioninfo}
# session info
sessionInfo()
```

### Time Frame {.tabset}

* The study population included patients from the “Berlin-SPecific Acute Treatment in Ischemic or hAemorrhagic Stroke With Long Term Follow-up” (B-SPATIAL, NCT03027453) registry that contains all stroke cases in Berlin, Germany from January 2016 to April 2021 and includes additional pre-hospital and in-hospital variables.
<br>
<br>
* Admission numbers at the begin and the end of the official time frame showed fluctuations in hospital admissions (e.g. due to roll-out period). Additionally, one station (MC171) measuring PM2.5 was put into operation in the mid of 2016.
<br>
<br>
* **This study uses only stroke data from February 1, 2017 to December 31, 2020**. Also see plot below.
<br>
<br>
<br>
<br>
![Javatpoint](hist_freq_adm_bspatial.png)

<br><br>

```{r, flowchart, results ='asis', echo=TRUE}
########## prep numbers
dat_raw <- stroke_dat

dat_raw <- dat_raw %>% 
  mutate(zip_loc=ifelse(zip_loc<10000,zip_loc+10000,zip_loc)) %>% 
  mutate(onset_symp_time2 = as.Date(dat_raw$onset_symp_time)) 

dat_raw <- dat_raw %>% 
  mutate(adm_before = ifelse(dat_raw$adm_time < dat_raw$onset_symp_time2, TRUE, FALSE)) 

# inclusion
n_cohort <- dat_raw %>% 
  nrow()

n_timeframe <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  nrow()

n_inclusion1 <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(icd10=="1" | icd10=="2") %>% 
  nrow()


n_inclusion2 <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(icd10=="1" | icd10=="2") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(onset_symp_time)) %>% 
  filter(adm_before != TRUE)  %>% 
  nrow()

n_inclusion3_df <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(icd10=="1" | icd10=="2") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(onset_symp_time)) %>% 
  filter(adm_before != TRUE)  
   
# identify duplicates
duplicates <- n_inclusion3_df %>%
  mutate(int_transf_numb=ifelse(!is.na(transf_number), transf_number, ifelse(!is.na(displ_numb), displ_numb, NA))) %>% # mutate variable with all transfer numbers
  select(pat_id_exp, adm_time, onset_symp_time, sex, age, transf, int_transf_numb, transf_number, displ_numb, adm_before, onset_symp_time2, everything()) %>% 
  filter(int_transf_numb==transf_number | int_transf_numb==displ_numb) %>% # filter by transf_number 
  arrange(onset_symp_time, pat_id_exp) %>% 
  group_by(int_transf_numb) %>% 
  fill(transf_number, displ_numb, living_pre, walk_ability_pre, aht, dm, atr_fibr, prior_event, hlp, chd, pm, le_1, ci, pavk, nic, nic_quant, zip_loc, .direction = "downup") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(transf_number) & !is.na(displ_numb))  # there were some single cases inside with only transf_numb or displ_numb but with no other match in other row

exclude_id <- duplicates %>% 
  group_by(int_transf_numb) %>% 
  slice(-1)

n_inclusion3_clean <- anti_join(n_inclusion3_df, exclude_id, by = "pat_id_exp")

n_inclusion3 <- n_inclusion3_clean %>% 
  nrow()

# exclusion
dat_ex1 <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01")
n_exclusion1 <- dat_ex1 %>% 
  filter(icd10=="3" | icd10=="4" | icd10=="5") %>% 
  nrow()

dat_ex2 <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(icd10=="1" | icd10=="2") 
n_exclusion2 <- dat_ex2 %>% 
  filter(adm_before == TRUE  | is.na(onset_symp_time)) %>% 
  nrow()

dat_ex3 <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(icd10=="1" | icd10=="2") %>% 
  filter(adm_before == FALSE  | !is.na(onset_symp_time)) 
  
n_exclusion3 <- nrow(dat_ex3) - nrow(n_inclusion3_clean)

########## draw flowcharts

fc_main <- tibble(from = c("B-SPATIAL\ncohort\n(N=)", 
                           "B-SPATIAL\ncohort\n(N=)", 
                           "B-SPATIAL\ncohort\n(N=)", 
                           "Time frame:\nFebruary 1, 2017 to December, 31, 2020\n(N=)", 
                           "Time frame:\nFebruary 1, 2017 to December, 31, 2020\n(N=)", 
                           "Inclusion (I):\nDischarge diagnosis of IS or TIA\n(N=)",
                           "Inclusion (I):\nDischarge diagnosis of IS or TIA\n(N=)",
                           "Inclusion (II):\nSymptom onset time available &\nplausible (N=)", 
                           "Inclusion (II):\nSymptom onset time available &\nplausible (N=)",  
                           "Inclusion (III):\nNo duplicates due to network transfer\n(N=)"),
                       to = c("Time frame:\nFebruary 1, 2017 to December, 31, 2020\n(N=)", 
                              "Time frame:\nFebruary 1, 2017 to December, 31, 2020\n(N=)", 
                              "Time frame:\nFebruary 1, 2017 to December, 31, 2020\n(N=)", 
                              "Inclusion (I):\nDischarge diagnosis of IS or TIA\n(N=)",
                              "Exclusion (I):\nOther discharge diagnosis\n(N=)", 
                              "Inclusion (II):\nSymptom onset time available &\nplausible (N=)", 
                              "Exclusion (II):\nSymptom onset time not available or\nimplausible (N=)", 
                              "Inclusion (III):\nNo duplicates due to network transfer\n(N=)", 
                              "Exclusion (III):\nDuplicates due to network transfer\n(N=)",  
                              "Study population\n(Main analyses)\n(N=)"))

fc_main$from[1] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_cohort, ""), fc_main$from[1])
fc_main$from[2] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_cohort, ""), fc_main$from[2])
fc_main$from[3] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_cohort, ""), fc_main$from[3])
fc_main$from[4] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_timeframe, ""), fc_main$from[4])
fc_main$from[5] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_timeframe, ""), fc_main$from[5])
fc_main$from[6] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion1, ""), fc_main$from[6])
fc_main$from[7] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion1, ""), fc_main$from[7])
fc_main$from[8] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion2, ""), fc_main$from[8])
fc_main$from[9] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion2, ""), fc_main$from[9])
fc_main$from[10] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion3, ""), fc_main$from[10])

fc_main$to[1] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_timeframe, ""), fc_main$to[1])
fc_main$to[2] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_timeframe, ""), fc_main$to[2])

fc_main$to[5] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_exclusion1, ""), fc_main$to[5])
fc_main$to[6] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion2, ""), fc_main$to[6])
fc_main$to[7] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_exclusion2, ""), fc_main$to[7])
fc_main$to[8] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion3, ""), fc_main$to[8])
fc_main$to[9] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_exclusion3, ""), fc_main$to[9])
fc_main$to[10] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=",n_inclusion3, ""), fc_main$to[10])


node_data_main <- tibble( name = c("B-SPATIAL\ncohort\n(N=14429)", 
                                   "Time frame:\nFebruary 1, 2017 to December, 31, 2020\n(N=13600)",

fc_main_gg <- ggflowchart(fc_main, node_data_main, fill=type, x_nudge = 0.49, y_nudge = 0.32, text_size = 2.75)  #0.42; 0.32

fc_main_gg +
```

### Inclusion & exclusion criteria {.tabset}

* Inclusion: The study population consisted of **patients with the primary discharge diagnosis of ischemic stroke or TIA**.
<br>
<br>
* Exclusion: **Patients with other discharge diagnoses (e.g., hemorrhagic stroke, stroke mimics), implausible or missing symptom onset times or those identified as transfer patients** were excluded 
<br>
<br>
* A total of 9,565 stroke patients from February 1, 2017, to December 31, 2020, were included in the final analyses. The case-control-ratio was 3.4.
<br>
<br>
```{r, stroke_types, results ='asis', echo=TRUE}
summary_types <- list(
   "Diagnosis at discharge (ICD10)" = list(
    "Ischemic stroke (I63-64)" = ~ n_perc0(dat_pandemic$icd10 == "I63-I64 (ischemic stroke)", na_rm = TRUE, show_denom = "never"),
    "Transisient ischemic attack (G45.0-G45.3/G45.8-G45.9)" = ~ n_perc0(dat_pandemic$icd10 == "G45-0 - G45-3, G45-8 - G45-9 (TIA)", na_rm = TRUE, show_denom = "never"),
    "Missing" = ~ n_perc0(is.na(icd10))))
tblq_types <- summary_table(dat_pandemic, summary_types)
print(tblq_types) 
```

<br>

```{r, Cases_controls, results ='asis', echo=TRUE}
cases <- sum(dat_analysis_pan_adj$stroke == "1")
controls <- sum(dat_analysis_pan_adj$stroke == "0")
case_control_ratio <- round(controls / cases,2)

summary_cc_ratio <- list(
   "Number of cases and controls" = list(
    "Number of cases" = ~ n_perc0(dat_analysis_pan_adj$stroke == "1", na_rm = TRUE, show_denom = "never"),
    "Number of controls" = ~ n_perc0(dat_analysis_pan_adj$stroke == "0", na_rm = TRUE, show_denom = "never"),
    "Ratio cases:controls" = ~ case_control_ratio,
    "Missing" = ~ n_perc0(is.na(dat_analysis_pan_adj$stroke))))
tblq_cc_ratio <- summary_table(dat_analysis_pan_adj, summary_cc_ratio)
print(tblq_cc_ratio) 
```

### {- .leave-tabset}


## Exposure data: BLUME network {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

### PM 2.5 monitoring stations {.tabset}
* Hourly PM2.5 air pollution data were obtained from the **Berlin air quality monitoring network** (BLUME). This network consists of 12 monitoring stations across Berlin, classified into three categories depending on their location at the outer limit of the city, on main streets, or in urban residential areas.
<br>
<br>
* **Hourly concentrations from the three urban residential stations were combined into a spatial median air pollution concentration on an hourly basis**.
<br>
<br>
* Although selecting only three of the twelve monitoring stations, **Pearson and Spearman correlation coefficients among all twelve stations and between the three stations are high**. 
<br>
<br>
* According to the definition of the German Federal Environmental Agency the **urban residential stations represent air pollution concentrations typical for the air quality in urban areas**.
<br>
<br>
* Real-time samples were collected using automatic stray light measurements (Grimm EDM-180 measuring device) and validated retrospectively by laboratory gravimetric reference methods based on 24-hour filter dust, adhering to German law (39th Ordinance on the Implementation of the Federal Immission Control Act (39. BImSchV)) and EU directive (2008/50/EG). 
<br>
<br>
* The BLUME PM2.5 air pollution data are available on the website https://luftdaten.berlin.de/pollution/pm25
<br>
<br>

### PM 2.5 values {.tabset}
* **Hourly concentrations from the three urban residential stations were combined into a spatial median air pollution concentration on an hourly basis**, which was then matched to the symptom onset times rounded to the closest full hour. Symptom onset times were rounded to the nearest full hour.
<br>
<br>

### ACF for PM2.5 exposure {.tabset}

* PM2.5 data for the study population shows **a strong positive correlation at the initial lags (close to 1.0)**, followed by a **gradual decrease in correlation over the first 36 hours**.
<br><br>
* The **same trend can be observed in the first 96 hours and the first week**.  
<br><br>
```{r, àcf, results='asis', echo=TRUE}
# calculate acf

##### 36 hours
# acf for total exposure 
acf_BLUME_36h_total <- ggAcf(exposure_pandemic$pm25_median_h_Z, lag.max = 36) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 36, by = 1),limits = c(0, 36), expand = c(0,1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)) +
  labs(title = "ACF Plot: Total PM 2.5 exposure in the first 36 hours from February 2017 to December 31, 2020") +
  theme_minimal()
# result: data shows very strong positive correlation (> 0.5-1.0) and a decreasing wave in the first 36 hours.
print(acf_BLUME_36h_total)

# acf for total study population
acf_BLUME_36h <- ggAcf(dat_analysis_pan_adj$pm25_median_h_Z, lag.max = 36) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 36, by = 1),limits = c(0, 36), expand = c(0,1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)) +
  labs(title = "ACF Plot: PM 2.5 exposure in the first 36 hours for the study population (N = 42,073)") +
  theme_minimal()
print(acf_BLUME_36h)

# acf for cases
acf_BLUME_36h_cases_df <- dat_analysis_pan_adj %>% 
  filter(stroke == "1") 

acf_BLUME_36h_cases <- ggAcf(acf_BLUME_36h_cases_df$pm25_median_h_Z, lag.max = 36) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 36, by = 1),limits = c(0, 36), expand = c(0,1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)) +
  labs(title = "ACF Plot: PM 2.5 exposure in the first 36 hours for cases (N = 9,565)") +
  theme_minimal()
print(acf_BLUME_36h_cases)

# acf for controls
acf_BLUME_36h_controls_df <- dat_analysis_pan_adj %>% 
  filter(stroke == "0") 

acf_BLUME_36h_controls <- ggAcf(acf_BLUME_36h_controls_df$pm25_median_h_Z, lag.max = 36) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 36, by = 1),limits = c(0, 36), expand = c(0,1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)) +
  labs(title = "ACF Plot: PM 2.5 exposure in the first 36 hours for controls (N = 32,508)") +
  theme_minimal()
print(acf_BLUME_36h_controls)

#### 96 & 168 hours

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 96, by = 1),limits = c(0, 96), expand = c(0,1)) +
```

## Adjustment data: DWD network {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

### German Weather Service stations {.tabset}
* Standardized **hourly data on relative humidity (%), air temperature (°C), and atmospheric pressure (hPa)** measured at a height of two meters were acquired from the **Climate Data Center of the German Weather Service** ( https://cdc.dwd.de/portal/), which maintains five monitoring stations in Berlin.
<br>
<br>
* Only the **three stations recording all three covariates simultaneously were included in our analysis**. Hourly values for each parameter were determined by calculating the spatial median value of the three stations. 
<br>
<br>
* **Correlation for the respective parameters among all stations** were **very strong** (r>0.99 for air temperature, air pressure & relative humidity).
<br>
<br>
* **Map description**: The 3 background BLUME stations are represented by the green points. The 3 red points represent the monitoring stations of the German Weather Service.
<br>
<br>
![Javatpoint](23042024_map_all_stations.png) 
<br><br>



### Meteorological values {.tabset}

* The hourly and daily values for the respective parameters were determined by **calculating the spatial median value based of the three stations (n=3; 400, 403, 427)**. 
<br>
<br>
* **Summary statistics table** showed annual values for all parameters for the time from **February 1, 2017, to December 31,2020**. 
<br>
<br>

### Distribution of the meteorological data {.tabset}

* All parameters showed a **non-linear distribution or deviations from normal distribution**.
<br>
<br>
* **Short summary of visual inspection**:
a) **Air pressure (AP)**: slightly left-skewed; rather non-linear distribution / deviation from normal distribution
b) **Relative humidity (RH)**: clearly left-skewed; rather non-linear distribution, s-shape in Q-Q plot
c) **Temperature (TM)**: M-shape in histogram (greater peak at approximately 10°C, second peak at approximately 20°C), both margins rather symmetrical; rather non-linear distribution, flat s-shape in Q-Q plot
<br>
<br>
* **Spearman and Pearson correlation analyses among meteorological parameters and PM2.5 values** showed **mainly weak correlations**.
<br>
<br>
* **PM2.5 values had the strongest correlation with** 
a) **relative humidity** (RH; weak positive correlation, r=0.32), 
b) **temperature** (TM; weak negative correlation, r=-0.30) and 
c) differed when stratified by weekday, daytime or public holiday.
<br>
<br>

### Dataset{.tabset}
* The original **time-series data format** was transferred into an **expanded matched case-control structure** (Yao Wu et al., 2021; Armstrong et al., 2014; Zhao, 2016; Mostofsky et al., 2018).
<br>
<br>
* The **times of the symptom onset were rounded to the fullest hour** to fit the time information to the exposure and adjustment data.
<br>
<br>
```{r analysis-dataset, echo=TRUE, results='asis'}
# example_dataset <- dat_analysis %>% 
#   select(pat_id_exp, strata, stroke,case_time, control_dates, all_dates, pm25_median_h_Z, hour_med_TM, hour_med_RH) %>% 
#   head(20)
# 
# print(example_dataset)

```
<br>
<br>
![Javatpoint](screen_datastructure.png) 


### Main analyses {.tabset}

**Main analyses method**:
<br>
**Conditional logistic regression (CLR)** was applied to assess the association of stroke and PM2.5 short-term exposure. Therefore, the **clogit()-function of the {survival}-package** and the **gam()-function of the {mgcv}-package** was used. Both functions calculate the CLR loglikelihood on the basis of a stratified Cox model (https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/survival/versions/3.5-7/topics/clogit). 
<br>
The **number of degrees for freedom for each meteorological covariate and each model analyses type** was specified by calculating the **Akaike information criterion (AIC)** for a range of potential df from one to ten. The **model with the lowest AIC value** was considered for the main and sensitivity analyses.
<br>
<br>
<br>
<br>
**Adjustments**:
<br>
To adjust for temperature, barometric pressure and relative humidity **natural splines** were included into the **clogit-function**. **Polynomial terms** and the **gam-function** (with the inner s-function) ere conducted as **sensitivity analyses**.
<br>
<br>
Recognizing **public holidays and pandemic measures as potential confounders of PM 2.5 concentration and stroke occurrence**, all public holidays between February 2017 and December 2020 and periods with repeated government-mandated pandemic measures were **included as binary indicator variables**. <br><br>
**Chosen timeframe of adjustment of pandemic measures**: Starting on March 13, 2020, pandemic-related nationwide measures were implemented (https://www.rki.de/DE/Content/InfAZ/N/Neuartiges_Coronavirus/Situationsberichte/2020-03-14-de.html). From this date until December 31, 2020, routine life was not fully restored, with varying degrees of measures in place throughout the period.
<br>
<br>
<br>
<br>
**Unit of outcome**:
<br>
By z-transforming the PM 2.5 exposure values we defined following outcome unit: "**For each 1 standard deviation increase in (z-transformed) PM 2.5 was associated with an XX times greater odds (adjusted Odds Ratio; aOR) of ischemic stroke (IS) or transient ischemic attack (TIA) (95% CI).**"
<br>
<br>



### Sensitivity analyses {.tabset}
<br>
a) To ensure methodological robustness and validate the results, the main analysis will be conducted with **two other non-linear adjustment methods (polynomial cubic terms vs.splines with given df (clogit::nsk()) vs. splines with automatic received df (mgcv::s()))**, but identical model specifications.
<br>
<br>
b) **Time restriction for pandemic measures** in 2020. 
<br>
<br>
c) **Differentiation into single ischemic stroke (IS) and single transient ischemic attack (TIA) analyses**

## Results {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

### Models {.tabset}

#### Covariates

**Covariates"":
<br>
<br>
Hourly relative humidity, hourly temperature, hourly barometric pressure, public holidays & pandemic measure periods.
(hour_med_RH, hour_med_TM, hour_med_AP, holidays, pandemic)
<br>
<br>
Model examples:
<br>
<br>

* eg. **clogit + natural splines** (df =1)
model11_clogit_nsk <- clogit(stroke ~ pm25_median_h_Z_sIQR +strata(strata) + 
                                   nsk(hour_med_AP, df = 1) +
                                   nsk(hour_med_RH, df = 1) +
                                   nsk(hour_med_TM, df = 1) +
                                   holidays +
                                   pandemic,dat_analysis_pan_adj)

* eg. **clogit + polynomial terms** (degree =1)
model11_clogit_polynom <- clogit(stroke ~ pm25_median_h_Z_sIQR +strata(strata) + 
                                   I(hour_med_AP^2) + I(hour_med_AP^1) + 
                                   I(hour_med_RH^2) + I(hour_med_RH^1) + 
                                   I(hour_med_TM^2) + I(hour_med_TM^1) +
                                   holidays +
                                  pandemic,dat_analysis_pan_adj)
                                   
* eg. **gam + smooth splines** (calculated df)
model11_gam <- gam(cbind(dummy,strata) ~ pm25_median_h_Z_sIQR + 
                                  s(hour_med_RH) + 
                                  s(hour_med_TM) + 
                                  s(hour_med_AP) + 
                                  holidays +
                                  pandemic, data=dat_analysis_pan_adj, family=cox.ph,weights=stroke)

<br>
<br>


#### Akaike information criterion (AIC)
<br>
For each type of analysis, **what number of degrees of freedom / degrees (1:10) results in the lowest AIC value**?
<br>
<br>
**nsk**: 1 df for temperature, relative humidity and air pressure <br>
**polynomial**: 5 degree for temperature, relative humidity and 1-2 degree for air pressure <br>
**gam**: 4.45 df for temperature, 1.01 df for relative humidity and 1.76 df for air pressure <br>
<br>
```{r, df_bestdf_nsk_loop2}
# loop nsk
model_nsk_df_sum_pan <- list()
df_values <- 1:10
for (df in df_values) {   
  model_name <- paste("model_clogit_nsk_df", df, sep = "_")   
  model <- clogit(stroke ~ pm25_median_h_Z + strata(strata) +
                    nsk(hour_med_AP, df = df) +
                    nsk(hour_med_RH, df = df) +
                    nsk(hour_med_TM, df = df) +
                    holidays +
                    pandemic, dat_analysis_pan_adj, method = "approximate")   
  model_nsk_df_sum_pan[[model_name]] <- model 
}

AIC_clogit_nsk_pan <- c(
AIC(model_nsk_df_sum_pan$model_clogit_nsk_df_1),
AIC(model_nsk_df_sum_pan$model_clogit_nsk_df_2),
AIC(model_nsk_df_sum_pan$model_clogit_nsk_df_3),
AIC(model_nsk_df_sum_pan$model_clogit_nsk_df_4),
AIC(model_nsk_df_sum_pan$model_clogit_nsk_df_5),
AIC(model_nsk_df_sum_pan$model_clogit_nsk_df_6),
AIC(model_nsk_df_sum_pan$model_clogit_nsk_df_7),
AIC(model_nsk_df_sum_pan$model_clogit_nsk_df_8),
AIC(model_nsk_df_sum_pan$model_clogit_nsk_df_9),
AIC(model_nsk_df_sum_pan$model_clogit_nsk_df_10))

AIC_clogit_nsk_pan_names <- c(
"model_clogit_nsk_df_1",
"model_clogit_nsk_df_2",
"model_clogit_nsk_df_3",
"model_clogit_nsk_df_4",
"model_clogit_nsk_df_5",
"model_clogit_nsk_df_6",
"model_clogit_nsk_df_7",
"model_clogit_nsk_df_8",
"model_clogit_nsk_df_9",
"model_clogit_nsk_df_10")

AIC_tbl_clogit_nsk_pan_df <- data.frame(Modnames = AIC_clogit_nsk_pan_names, AIC = AIC_clogit_nsk_pan) 
AIC_tbl_clogit_nsk_pan_df <- AIC_tbl_clogit_nsk_pan_df %>% 
  arrange(AIC)

AIC_tbl_clogit_nsk_pan_df %>% 
  knitr::kable() %>% 
  kable_styling()
```

### Primary Analysis

#### **Research question 1**: 
<br>
<br>
**RQ1**: Is there an **association between short-term increases in PM2.5 concentration and the odds of ischemic stroke and transient ischemic attacks among participants of the Berlin-based B-SPATIAL stroke registry**?
<br>
<br>
<br>
```{r, prim_results1, results='asis',echo=TRUE}
model1 <- list(
  "Unadjusted Model" = clogit(stroke ~ pm25_median_h_Z +strata(strata),dat_analysis_pan_adj),
  "Adjusted Model with df =1" = clogit(stroke ~ pm25_median_h_Z +strata(strata) + 
                                   nsk(hour_med_AP, df = 1) +
                                   nsk(hour_med_RH, df = 1) +
                                   nsk(hour_med_TM, df = 1) +
                                   holidays + 
                                   pandemic,dat_analysis_pan_adj))

print(model1)
```
<br>
<br>
```{r, prim_results2, results='asis',echo=TRUE}
modelsummary(model1,
             coef_rename = c("pm25_median_h_Z_sIQR" = "PM 2.5 [µg/m3]", 
                             "nsk(hour_med_AP, df = 3)1" = "Barometric pressure [hPa], df = 1", 
                             "nsk(hour_med_AP, df = 3)2" = "Barometric pressure [hPa], df = 2", 
                             "nsk(hour_med_AP, df = 3)3" = "Barometric pressure [hPa], df = 3", 
                             "nsk(hour_med_RH, df = 3)1" = "Relative humidity [%], df = 1", 
                             "nsk(hour_med_RH, df = 3)2" = "Relative humidity [%], df = 2", 
                             "nsk(hour_med_RH, df = 3)3" = "Relative humidity [%], df = 3", 
                             "nsk(hour_med_TM, df = 3)1" = "Temperature [°C], df = 1", 
                             "nsk(hour_med_TM, df = 3)2" = "Temperature [°C], df = 2", 
                             "nsk(hour_med_TM, df = 3)3" = "Temperature [°C], df = 3", 
                             "holidaysYes" = "Public Holidays",
                             "pandemicYes" = "Pandemic"),
             estimate = "estimate",
            statistic = c("conf.int",
                           "{std.error}", 
                           "{statistic}",
                           "{p.value}"),
             shape = term ~ model + statistic,
             conf_level=.95,
             output = "html",
             fmt=3,
             exponentiate = TRUE,
            gof_map = c("nobs"))
```


### Secondary Analysis 1

#### **Research question 2**: <br>
<br>
<br>
 If there is an association between PM2.5 short-term exposure and stroke, **at which time lag is it the strongest** (based on hours and the symptom onset time; Lags: **6-36 hours (single hour steps)**, **06-36 hours (cumulative hourly intervals)**.
<br>
<br>

#### **Single lag analysis**: association between stroke and single median lag values of PM2.5
<br>
<br>

### Secondary Analysis 2
<br>
<br>
#### **Research question 2**: <br>
If there is an association between PM2.5 short-term exposure and stroke, **at which time lag is it the strongest** (based on hours and the symptom onset time; Lags: **6-36 hours (single hour steps)**, **06-36 hours (cumulative hourly intervals)**.
<br>
<br>


#### **Cumulative lag analysis**: association between stroke and cumulative (rolling) lag values of PM2.5

<br><br>

#### **Pandemic time restriction**
<br><br>
**Time restriction and pandemic adjustment** (starting from March 14, 2020) due to nationwide pandemic measures in 2020
<br><br>
```{r, flowchart_restriction, results ='asis', echo=TRUE}

dat_raw <- stroke_dat

dat_raw <- dat_raw %>% 
  mutate(zip_loc=ifelse(zip_loc<10000,zip_loc+10000,zip_loc))

# inclusion
n_cohort <- dat_raw %>% 
  nrow()

n_timeframe <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(adm_time <= "2020-03-14") %>% 
  nrow()

n_inclusion1 <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(adm_time <= "2020-03-14") %>% 
  filter(icd10=="1" | icd10=="2") %>% 
  nrow()


n_inclusion2 <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(adm_time < "2020-03-13") %>% 
  filter(icd10=="1" | icd10=="2") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(onset_symp_time)) %>% 
  nrow()

tast <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(adm_time < "2020-03-13") %>% 
  filter(icd10=="1" | icd10=="2") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(onset_symp_time)) %>% 
 filter(!is.na(zip_loc)) %>% 
  filter(zip_loc < "14200")

 n_inclusion3_df <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(adm_time < "2020-03-13") %>% 
  filter(icd10=="1" | icd10=="2") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(onset_symp_time)) 

# identify duplicates
duplicates <- tast  %>% # n_inclusion3_df
  mutate(int_transf_numb=ifelse(!is.na(transf_number), transf_number, ifelse(!is.na(displ_numb), displ_numb, NA))) %>% # mutate variable with all transfer numbers
  select(pat_id_exp, adm_time, onset_symp_time, sex, age, transf, int_transf_numb, transf_number, displ_numb, everything()) %>% 
  filter(int_transf_numb==transf_number | int_transf_numb==displ_numb) %>% # filter by transf_number 
  arrange(onset_symp_time, pat_id_exp) %>% 
  group_by(int_transf_numb) %>% 
  fill(transf_number, displ_numb, living_pre, walk_ability_pre, aht, dm, atr_fibr, prior_event, hlp, chd, pm, le_1, ci, pavk, nic, nic_quant, zip_loc, .direction = "downup") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(transf_number) & !is.na(displ_numb))  # there were some single cases inside with only transf_numb or displ_numb but with no other match in other row

exclude_id <- duplicates %>% 
  group_by(int_transf_numb) %>% 
  slice(-1)

n_inclusion3_clean <- anti_join(n_inclusion3_df, exclude_id, by = "pat_id_exp")

n_inclusion3 <- n_inclusion3_clean %>% 
  nrow()




# exclusion
dat_ex1 <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(adm_time < "2020-03-13") 
n_exclusion1 <- dat_ex1 %>% 
  filter(icd10=="3" | icd10=="4" | icd10=="5") %>% 
  nrow()

dat_ex2 <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(adm_time < "2020-03-13") %>% 
  filter(icd10=="1" | icd10=="2")
n_exclusion2 <- dat_ex2 %>% 
  filter(is.na(onset_symp_time)) %>% 
  nrow()

dat_ex3 <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(year(adm_time) < "2021", year(adm_time) > "2016") %>% 
  filter(adm_time >= "2017-02-01") %>% 
  filter(adm_time < "2020-03-13") %>% 
  filter(icd10=="1" | icd10=="2") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(onset_symp_time)) 
n_exclusion3 <- nrow(dat_ex3) - nrow(n_inclusion3_clean)

########## draw flowcharts

fc_main <- tibble(from = c("B-SPATIAL\ncohort\n(N=)", 
                           "B-SPATIAL\ncohort\n(N=)", 
                           "B-SPATIAL\ncohort\n(N=)", 
                           "Time frame:\nFebruary 1, 2017 to March, 13, 2020\n(N=)", 
                           "Time frame:\nFebruary 1, 2017 to March, 13, 2020\n(N=)",

                           "Inclusion (II):\nSymptom onset time available &\nplausible (N=)", 
                           "Inclusion (II):\nSymptom onset time available &\nplausible (N=)",  
                           "Inclusion (III):\nNo duplicates due to network transfer\n(N=)"),
                       to = c("Time frame:\nFebruary 1, 2017 to March, 13, 2020\n(N=)", 
                              "Time frame:\nFebruary 1, 2017 to March, 13, 2020\n(N=)", 
                              "Time frame:\nFebruary 1, 2017 to March, 13, 2020\n(N=)", 
                              "Inclusion (I):\nDischarge diagnosis of IS or TIA\n(N=)",
                              "Exclusion (I):\nOther discharge diagnosis\n(N=)", 
                              "Inclusion (II):\nSymptom onset time available &\nplausible (N=)", 
                              "Exclusion (II):\nSymptom onset time not available or\nimplausible (N=)", 
                              "Inclusion (III):\nNo duplicates due to network transfer\n(N=)", 
                              "Exclusion (III):\nDuplicates due to network transfer\n(N=)",  
                              "Study population\n(Main analyses)\n(N=)"))

fc_main$from[1] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_cohort, ""), fc_main$from[1])
fc_main$from[2] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_cohort, ""), fc_main$from[2])
fc_main$from[3] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_cohort, ""), fc_main$from[3])
fc_main$from[4] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_timeframe, ""), fc_main$from[4])
fc_main$from[5] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_timeframe, ""), fc_main$from[5])
fc_main$from[6] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion1, ""), fc_main$from[6])
fc_main$from[7] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion1, ""), fc_main$from[7])
fc_main$from[8] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion2, ""), fc_main$from[8])
fc_main$from[9] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion2, ""), fc_main$from[9])
fc_main$from[10] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion3, ""), fc_main$from[10])

fc_main$to[1] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_timeframe, ""), fc_main$to[1])
fc_main$to[2] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_timeframe, ""), fc_main$to[2])
fc_main$to[3] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_timeframe, ""), fc_main$to[3])
fc_main$to[4] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion1, ""), fc_main$to[4])
fc_main$to[5] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_exclusion1, ""), fc_main$to[5])
fc_main$to[6] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion2, ""), fc_main$to[6])
fc_main$to[7] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_exclusion2, ""), fc_main$to[7])
fc_main$to[8] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_inclusion3, ""), fc_main$to[8])
fc_main$to[9] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=", n_exclusion3, ""), fc_main$to[9])
fc_main$to[10] <- gsub("N=", paste0("N=",n_inclusion3, ""), fc_main$to[10])


node_data_main <- tibble( name = c("B-SPATIAL\ncohort\n(N=14429)", 
                                   "Time frame:\nFebruary 1, 2017 to March, 13, 2020\n(N=10752)",
```

#### **Single ischemic stroke (IS) and single transient ischemic attack (TIA) analyses**

Differentiation into single ischemic stroke (IS) and single transient ischemic attack (TIA) analyses
<br><br>
<br><br>
```{r, sens_IS_TIA, results='asis',echo=TRUE}

dat_analysis_pan_adj_TIA <- dat_analysis_pan_adj %>% 
  filter(icd10=="G45-0 - G45-3, G45-8 - G45-9 (TIA)")

dat_analysis_pan_adj_IS <- dat_analysis_pan_adj %>% 
  filter(icd10 =="I63-I64 (ischemic stroke)")

model_sens_IS_TIA <- list(
  "Only TIA" = clogit(stroke ~ pm25_median_h_Z +strata(strata) + 
                                   nsk(hour_med_AP, df = 1) +
                                   nsk(hour_med_RH, df = 1) +
                                   nsk(hour_med_TM, df = 1) +
                                   holidays + 
                                   pandemic,dat_analysis_pan_adj_TIA),
  "Only IS" = clogit(stroke ~ pm25_median_h_Z +strata(strata) +

                                   nsk(hour_med_TM, df = 1) +
                                   holidays + 
                                   pandemic,dat_analysis_pan_adj_IS))

print(model_sens_IS_TIA)
```

```{r, sec_results_lag_plot, results='asis',echo=FALSE}
    textGrob("Lag  0h: OR 1.019 \nLag 18h: OR 1.015", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, gp = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"))
    ), xmin = 1.036, xmax = 1.049, ymin = 26, ymax = 37)
  
print(list_m2_lag_plot)
```

```{r, sec_results_roll_plot, results='asis',echo=FALSE}
  annotation_custom(

    rectGrob(gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = "black")),
    textGrob("Lag     0h: OR 1.019 \nLag 0-28h: OR 1.007", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, gp = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"))
    ), xmin = 1.037, xmax = 1.048, ymin = 26, ymax = 37)

print(list_m2_rollall_plot) 

```

```{r, km_plots}
options(digits = 7)

#### load

geo_DE <- read.delim("sens_analysis_km\\DE.txt")
geo_plz_berlin <- geojson_sf("plz-berlin.geojson")
zip_pop <- read_csv("25072024_zip_population.csv")
zip_pop <- zip_pop %>%
    separate(`zip;population`, into = c("zip", "population"), sep = ";") %>% 
  rename(zip_code = zip)

zip_pop$zip_code <- as.integer(zip_pop$zip_code)
  


#### Prepare

geo_Berlin <- geo_DE %>% 
  filter(BB == "BE")

colnames(geo_Berlin)[2] = "zip_code"
colnames(geo_Berlin)[10] = "latitude"
colnames(geo_Berlin)[11] = "longitude"

geo_Berlin <- geo_Berlin[,-(1)]
geo_Berlin <- geo_Berlin[,-(2:8)]
geo_Berlin <- geo_Berlin[,-(4)]

#### Counting

counts <- table(dat_zip$zip_loc) # count strokes by zip code

comb_geo_Berlin <- merge(geo_Berlin, data.frame(zip_code = names(counts), count = as.integer(counts), all.x = TRUE, by = 'zip_code'))

comb_geo_Berlin$count[is.na(comb_geo_Berlin$count)] <- 0

comb_geo_Berlin <- left_join(comb_geo_Berlin, zip_pop, by = "zip_code")

comb_geo_Berlin$count <- as.numeric(comb_geo_Berlin$count)
comb_geo_Berlin$population <- as.numeric(comb_geo_Berlin$population)

comb_geo_Berlin <- comb_geo_Berlin %>%  
  mutate(incidence_100 = round((count/population)*100000)) 

comb_geo_Berlin <- comb_geo_Berlin %>%  
  mutate(inc_cat = cut(incidence_100, 
                       breaks = c(-Inf, 99, 199, Inf), 
                       labels = c("0-99", "100-199", "200+"), 
                       include.lowest = TRUE))
```

```{r, corr_plots, results='asis',echo=TRUE}
# SPEARSON
corr_spear <- all_dat %>% 
  select(pm25_median_h, hour_med_AP, hour_med_RH, hour_med_TM) %>% 
  cor(use="complete.obs", method = "spearman")
colnames(corr_spear) <- c("PM 2.5", "AP", "RH", "TM")
rownames(corr_spear) <- c("PM 2.5", "AP", "RH", "TM")
corrplot(corr_spear, method = "color", type = "full", order = "alphabet", tl.cex = 1, tl.col = 'black', addCoef.col = "black", main="a. Spearman coefficients", mar = c(12,0,1,2), cl.pos = 'b', tl.pos = 'd', diag = FALSE)
 
testRes = cor.mtest(corr_spear, conf.level = 0.95)
colnames(corr_spear) <- c("PM 2.5", "AP", "RH", "TM")
rownames(corr_spear) <- c("PM 2.5", "AP", "RH", "TM")

# PEARSON
corr_pear <- all_dat %>% 
  select(pm25_median_h, hour_med_AP, hour_med_RH, hour_med_TM) %>% 
  cor(use="complete.obs", method = "spearman")
colnames(corr_pear) <- c("PM 2.5", "AP", "RH", "TM")
rownames(corr_pear) <- c("PM 2.5", "AP", "RH", "TM")
corrplot(corr_pear, method = "color", type = "full", order = "alphabet", tl.cex = 1, tl.col = 'black', addCoef.col = "black", main="b. Pearman coefficients", mar = c(12,0,1,2), cl.pos = 'b', tl.pos = 'd', diag = FALSE)
 
testRes = cor.mtest(corr_pear, conf.level = 0.95)
colnames(corr_pear) <- c("PM 2.5", "AP", "RH", "TM")
rownames(corr_pear) <- c("PM 2.5", "AP", "RH", "TM")
```
